purpose: ship a small, planned release of fixes and low-risk changes with the same controls as any production change
entry_criteria: Scope is limited to fixes and low-risk changes
Changes are merged, tested and linked to work items
procedure: Confirm each change is in scope for a maintenance release and has passed review and tests.
Cut the release candidate and run regression and smoke tests against it.
Check migration and configuration changes and the rollback plan for the release.
Obtain change approval and schedule the window outside freezes.
Deploy using the standard path, verify with smoke tests and watch the metrics.
Publish release notes and record the outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Regression and smoke tests passed on the candidate
validation_method: Release manager decision with change approval where required.

validation.expect: every commit maps to an in-scope work item

failure_modes.detection: Commit for new functionality in the list
failure_modes.response: Remove it or move to a feature release

failure_modes.mode: Skipped testing because the release is small
failure_modes.response: Run it; small releases break too

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Release 2.3.1 contains seven fixes. Regression and smoke tests pass on the candidate, the change board approves a Tuesday window, and the release notes list each fix.
